_설명: 『運転手のくせに』 PHASE 4 키프레임 pilot: 3컷 x 후보 2장 = 6장, 약 0.24달러. 생성: scripts/build_untenshu_keyframes.py (스토리보드 keyframe_prompt + 시트 칸 참조).

characters.prompt: Create ONE single photorealistic cinematic film still — one frame only, NOT a grid. Reference images: the people's faces, hair and clothes must match their reference images exactly (same person); the last reference is the location — keep its space and lighting. Photorealistic live-action Japanese TV drama, Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, 16:9, restrained Japanese film mise-en-scene, natural lived-in detail, no flat lighting. Over the driver's headrest (soft in the foreground, left): Otsuka exploding with rage in the back seat, leaning forward, pointing a finger, red brake light on his face. Characters: Otsuka Koji, a thickset Japanese man aged 45, a broad ruddy face, thick heavy black eyebrows, black hair stiffly gelled with a hard side parting, clean-shaven, no glasses, a gold wristwatch on his LEFT wrist, wearing a grey pinstripe business suit with the loud red paisley necktie loosened, jacket rumpled and damp from the rain | Kuroda Soichiro the taxi driver, a lean Japanese man aged 67, a long calm dignified face, thick white hair swept back under the cap, a short neatly trimmed white moustache, one small dark mole on his RIGHT cheek, no glasses, wearing a plain navy peaked driver's cap with no badge, plain white cotton gloves, a white shirt with a plain navy V-neck vest, the listener in the soft blurred foreground seen only from behind (back of the head and one shoulder), face not visible. People look like real Japanese drama actors photographed on set: real skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, natural matte skin, restrained believable expressions, bare unadorned earlobes and no jewellery. Camera: low-angle looking up, 85mm prime lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus on the irises, soft optical bokeh. Lighting: inside a taxi at night: harsh red brake-light reflection from the car ahead flooding the cabin, teal shadows, tension. Over-the-shoulder conversation shot: the listener's blurred shoulder and back of the head fill the left edge of the foreground; the speaker faces the listener at a three-quarter angle (30 to 40 degrees from the camera), the speaker's face at least one quarter of the frame height, sharp focus on the speaker's eyes, hands doing the described action. All papers, screens, signs, cards and labels are completely blank; no letters, numbers or symbols anywhere in the frame. Any car license plate is a plain green plate with a thin white border and no characters; any taxi roof lamp is a plain white dome with no characters. Negative: gibberish, foreign text, incomprehensible letters, fake alphabets, blurry typography, text on badge, text on name tag, logo on shirt, signage lettering, kanji on lanterns, posters with writing, documents with writing, screens with text, printed labels, brand logos, characters on license plates, watermarks, stamps, symbols on collar, bad anatomy, deformed eyes, extra fingers, extra arms, duplicate people, blood, gore, police. Over-the-shoulder conversation framing: the speaker's face fills at least one quarter of the frame height and is in razor-sharp focus; the listener's shoulder and back of the head are a soft blurred shape at the frame edge; the speaker's mouth is gently CLOSED in this frame (speech is added later), emotion shown in the eyes, brows and jaw. Natural five-fingered hands only where described. CAMERA: low angle, looking up. The person marked 'seen only from behind' shows only the back of the head and shoulders; the face is NOT visible at all. Every paper, document, card, screen, meter display, license plate and roof lamp surface is completely blank and clean: NO characters, NO numbers (Japanese text is composited later). Full-frame 16:9 image filling the whole canvas: NO black bars, NO white borders, NO letterbox or pillarbox.
